name_reason: Current name has the misleading suffix 'at_xy' implying it takes destination x/y coordinates, but the body always RLE-blits at the fixed origin (0, 0) -- there are NO xy params. The 4th arg is sprite_idx (index into the atlas offset table), not an x coordinate (both the Ghidra plate and src comment already flag this). Proposed 'fd2_blit_indexed_sprite_rle' follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>, keeps the file-consistent 'indexed_sprite' wording (cf. fd2_blit_indexed_sprite_with_alloc, fd2_alloc_and_blit_indexed_sprite_chunk), drops the false 'at_xy', and adds 'rle' to distinguish it from the raw/opaque offset-table sibling fd2_blit_sheet_sprite_at_offset @ 0x1685C. No address residue.
purpose: Thin wrapper that looks up sub-sprite `sprite_idx` in a sprite-atlas sheet's offset table and RLE-blits it with transparent passthrough at origin (0, 0) within dst.
logic_summary: Resolves sprite_addr = sheet + *(int32*)(sheet + 6 + sprite_idx*4) (4-byte-per-entry offset table starting at sheet+6), then calls fd2_rle_blit_sprite(sprite_addr, dst_x=0, dst_y=0, dst, dst_pitch, palette_op=0xFFFFFFFF). palette_op 0xFFFFFFFF selects RLE PASSTHROUGH (transparent skip-runs preserved, opaque pixels copied unchanged). Body is preceded by the compiler-generated __CHK(0x20) stack-probe prologue (omitted in src). Single basic block, cyclomatic complexity 1.
signature: void fd2_blit_indexed_sprite_at_xy(uint32 dst, uint32 dst_pitch, uint32 sheet, uint32 sprite_idx)

params.name: param_1
params.semantics: Destination base linear address (passed straight through to fd2_rle_blit_sprite as dst_buf).
params.reason: param_1 is a generic placeholder; arg is the destination buffer base. src already names it 'dst'.

params.name: param_2
params.semantics: Destination row stride in bytes (passed through as the rle blit's stride arg).
params.reason: param_2 is a generic placeholder; arg is the destination row stride. src already names it 'dst_pitch'.

params.name: param_3
params.semantics: Sprite-atlas sheet base linear address; offset table read at sheet+6, sprite header at sheet + table[sprite_idx].
params.reason: param_3 is a generic placeholder; arg is the atlas sheet base. src already names it 'sheet'.

params.name: screen_x
params.semantics: Index into the sheet's 4-byte-per-entry offset table (selects which sub-sprite). NOT a screen x coordinate.
params.reason: Name 'screen_x' is actively wrong/misleading: the value is the atlas sprite index used as table[6 + screen_x*4], never an x coordinate (rle blit's dst_x is hardcoded 0). src already names it 'sprite_idx'.

returns.semantics: No return value (void). The binary leaves EAX as set by fd2_rle_blit_sprite; no caller consumes a result.
